unresolved_should_improve.claim: Several beats are removed: the pause in which Tommy's assurance 'was at last conquering', the German's 'What do you mean?' and Tommy's parry, Boris's fist, Boris's sullen 'you do not', and the 'mind reader' aside. In the revision, Tommy fires 'Do I look…' straight after the clerk's challenge, then continues with 'And why am I so confident?' with no reply in between.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: Tommy's question can be read as rhetorical, and the heartbeat line still conveys his fear.

evidence.quote: “No,” admitted Boris at last sullenly, “you do not.”
“Thank God, he’s not a mind reader,” thought Tommy. Aloud he pursued his advantage:
Tommy hated him. Had the man seen through him? “Do I look as though I thought there were the least chance of your killing me?” said Tommy calmly.
“And why am I so confident? Because I know something that puts me in a position to propose a bargain.”
“No,” admitted Boris at last sullenly, “you do not.”

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: After revision paragraph 31, restore Boris's 'No… you do not.' and 'Thank God, he's not a mind reader,' thought Tommy.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Paras 58–63 may be condensed under the optional list, but the plan asks to keep the mind-reader aside if space allows. The first draft showed it fits.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The clerk's doubt is never overcome on stage, so the reversal that justifies 'And why am I so confident?' is missing. The plan-favoured comic undercut ('not a mind reader') is also lost.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Bluff turning point loses Boris's concession; Tommy's challenge is left unanswered

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The German's baffled 'Then--then----', the first draft's 'Tommy went on' tag, and 'Tommy raised his hand, and silenced the clamours of disgust' are all cut. Paragraphs 42, 43 and 45 are Tommy speaking with no tags, separated only by an unattributed 'Pah!'.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The content makes Tommy the evident speaker throughout.

evidence.quote: Tommy raised his hand, and silenced the clamours of disgust.
Again Tommy shook his head. “Not in the least.”
“I don’t know where the papers are--but I believe that I can find them. I have a theory----”
“I don’t know where the papers are--but I believe that I can find them. I have a theory----” Tommy went on.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore 'Then--then----' angry and baffled, the words failed him. before paragraph 43, and put 'Tommy raised his hand, and silenced the clamours of disgust.' before paragraph 45.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: These lines fall within the required bargain section and are not listed as optional.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: New paragraphs conventionally signal a change of speaker, so readers briefly misassign lines. The 'Pah!' reads as a single speaker rather than the group's collective disgust that Tommy overrides, which weakens his staged control of the room.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Bargain becomes untagged consecutive Tommy speeches around an orphaned 'Pah!'

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision drops 'Conrad lit a hissing gas burner and went out.' The windowless cell now has no stated light, yet 018's revision has Annette turn out the light and Conrad go 'towards the gas'. That chapter also cut its own gas-burner mention.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: Readers may assume some light. The key turning implies Conrad's exit.

evidence.quote: Conrad lit a hissing gas burner and went out. Tommy heard the sound of the key being turned in the lock.
On the floor above Conrad opened a door and Tommy passed into a small room. Tommy heard the sound of the key being turned in the lock.
Conrad lit a hissing gas burner and went out.
The door opened. Conrad went straight towards the gas to light it.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Reinsert 'Conrad lit a hissing gas burner and went out.' in revision paragraph 81.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: This is a planning omission: the plan did not flag the gas light as a cross-chapter dependency.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: This is a physical mechanism of the escape: the darkness covers the passing of the penknife. It now lacks an antecedent, and Tommy examining a windowless room with no light is slightly incongruous.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Gas burner cut, leaving the next chapter's light mechanism without local setup

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision removes the German's opening 'put to death as a spy' and Tommy's 'Simply lots of things'. It also removes Tommy's 'His hasty action has given me the pleasure of seeing you all face to face', the whole 'Dead men tell no tales' run, and 'Let me ask you one for a change'. The plan allowed shortening paras 28–33 while keeping one or two lines; none remain.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: A captured spy's peril is self-evident, and the 'kill me off' logic still lands.

evidence.quote: Don’t blame the poor fellow. His hasty action has given me the pleasure of seeing you all face to face.
“Dead men tell no tales,” he said evenly.
“Can you give us any reason why we should not put you to death?” asked the German.
“Several,” replied Tommy. “Why didn’t you kill me off at once before I regained consciousness?”
“Dead men tell no tales,” said the German evenly.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore 'Dead men tell no tales' / 'Ah, but I'm not dead yet!' after Conrad's excuse, and 'Let me ask you one for a change.' after 'Several'.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Optional tradeoff, overextended: the plan kept one or two lines of paras 28–33.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The reason they must kill him, that he has seen their faces, goes unstated, and the death sentence first appears inside a question. Tommy's reply 'Several' no longer turns the interrogation around with 'one for a change', which weakens the escalation that his bluff answers.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Opening threat and 'face to face' provocation cut beyond the optional allowance
